import json,collections
rs=[json.loads(l) for l in open('items.jsonl')];a=[json.loads(l) for l in open('answers.jsonl')]
for n,s in enumerate(['ъь','ьъъ','ъ','ъъъъъъ','ьъ','ъъъ','ьъъъъ'],89):
 a.append(dict(item_id=rs[n-1]['item_id'],slots={str(i+1):c for i,c in enumerate(s)},confidence={str(i+1):'high' for i in range(len(s))},unmarked_final_hard_signs=[],pre1918='yes',note=''))
a[50]['slots']['1']='ь';a[50]['pre1918']='no'
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for o in a:f.write(json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
assert len(a)==len(rs)==95
for r,o in zip(rs,a):
 assert r['item_id']==o['item_id']
 expected={str(i) for i in range(1,r['slots']+1)}
 assert set(o['slots'])==set(o['confidence'])==expected
 assert all(c in ['ъ','ь','other','u'] for c in o['slots'].values())
 assert all(c in ['high','low'] for c in o['confidence'].values())
 assert o['pre1918'] in ['yes','no','unclear']
c=collections.Counter(c for o in a for c in o['slots'].values())
print('Validated count, order, slot coverage:',len(a),'items')
print('Slot calls:',dict(c),'total',sum(c.values()))
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(o['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for o in a))
